labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The test runner now returns a non-zero exit code for unexpected successes, which can make existing CI pipelines fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: CsrfViewMiddleware no longer masks the CSRF cookie, a behavior change that can affect code relying on the previous cookie value.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The middleware now stores the unmasked secret in request.META['CSRF_COOKIE'], a changed internal value that custom code may depend on.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: ModelAdmin.actions and inlines now default to tuples, so code that mutates these attributes in place will break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The type="text/css" attribute is removed from CSS form media link tags, changing rendered output that tests or custom code may check.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: formset:added and formset:removed events no longer depend on jQuery, so custom JavaScript relying on jQuery event handling will stop working.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The exc_info argument of log_response() is replaced by exception, which breaks any caller using the old argument name.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The size argument of was_modified_since() is removed, so callers passing it will fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The admin log out UI now uses POST requests, so bookmarked or GET-based logout links will no longer work.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The InlineAdminFormSet.non_form_errors property is replaced by a method, so template or code access to the property will break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The cached template loader is now enabled in development, a changed default that can alter template behavior during development.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: SuccessURLAllowedHostsMixin is replaced by RedirectURLMixin, so code subclassing the removed mixin will break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Custom BaseConstraint subclasses must now implement validate(), so existing constraints without it need code changes.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: URLResolver._is_callback(), URLResolver._callback_strs, and URLPattern.lookup_str() are moved, breaking any code that imports or calls them from their old location.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Model.full_clean now converts exclude to a set and sets are preferred for exclude arguments, so code passing other types to these methods may be affected.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The minimum supported asgiref version is raised from 3.4.1 to 3.5.2, requiring dependency upgrades where older versions are pinned.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Combined expressions no longer guess output_field and may crash with mixed types, so affected queries need an explicitly set output_field.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: makemessages no longer updates .po files when they are up to date, a behavior change that can affect workflows checking or diffing translation files.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Logging out via GET is deprecated but still works, so it needs no immediate action beyond planning a move to POST.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: The flat-list sitemap index context is deprecated with only a warning, so custom templates can be updated later without breaking now.
